name: branding-shared-bindings
goal: Resolve new shared brand imports in the source index and keep the stored dependency graph fresh

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Full e7caf1a7 check failed two alias guards: NavBar, ProjectGate and HubFrame import BrandMark through undeclared source references. Dependency contracts alone do not resolve source indexing.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Original full: 2 failed, 766 passed, 25 skipped. Controlled freeze expands only the exact Search+BrandMark expected list: same 8 guards fail 2/pass 6 before configuration repair; controlled-red.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added three exact source-reference declarations; converted their dependency origins to derived and reconciled through units index. Added the existing alias-guard handoff requirement to AGENTS.md.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same controlled 8 guards pass unchanged after repair; existing shared-alias-index adds 5 passes: 13/13 in controlled-green.log. Runtime logo/helper/assets remain byte-identical.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
